modules.name: Compact Tracking Laser
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; strong small-target tracking.

modules.name: Sustained Beam
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; efficient against larger targets.

modules.name: Pulse Laser
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; concentrated cycle with lower reach.

modules.name: Long-Range Emitter
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; reach trades against power and tracking.

modules.name: Laser Battery
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; larger fitting and activation demand.

modules.name: Heavy Beam Cannon
modules.effect: Direct thermal damage; inefficient against small evasive targets.

modules.name: Ion Shield Breaker
modules.effect: 130% damage to shields, 50% to hull; no resource drain.

modules.name: Ion Engine Disruptor
modules.effect: Normal ion damage; landed hit slows 15% for 4s; soft-control family rules.

modules.name: Ion Capacitor Disruptor
modules.effect: Normal ion damage; landed hit destroys 6 capacitor; drains do not scale with damage quality.

modules.name: Rapid Light Missile Launcher
modules.effect: One light missile/shot; 4 credits reference ammunition cost.

modules.name: Assault Missile Launcher
modules.effect: One assault missile/shot; 15 credits reference ammunition cost.

modules.name: Heavy Torpedo Launcher
modules.effect: One torpedo/shot, 30 credits; 2s visible preparation; committed burst.

modules.name: Bombardment Launcher
modules.effect: One bomb/shot, 70 credits; 3s preparation; selected heavy ship or objective, no unbounded area payload.

modules.name: Shield Capacity Bank
modules.effect: +60 shield capacity, -15 capacitor capacity; no combat recharge.

modules.name: Shield Recharge Array
modules.effect: +0.6 shield/s out of combat, -10% base shield capacity.

modules.name: Emergency Shield Booster
modules.effect: Self shield recovery; ordinary recovery mastery applies.

modules.name: Self Hull Repairer
modules.effect: Self hull recovery; cannot repair above maximum.

modules.name: Focused Shield Repairer
modules.effect: Self or allied shield recovery; external reception budget applies.

modules.name: Allied Hull Repair Projector
modules.effect: Allied hull recovery; external reception budget applies.

modules.name: Repair Field Generator
modules.effect: 54 total hull recovery split among up to 3 allies within 8m, including source only if damaged; one total pool.

modules.name: Capacitor Storage Bank
modules.effect: +50 capacitor capacity, -10% base capacitor regeneration.

modules.name: Capacitor Recovery Regulator
modules.effect: +0.6 capacitor/s, -10% base capacitor capacity; maximum 2 fitted.

modules.name: Consumable Fuel Injector
modules.effect: Consumes one injector charge per use, 6 credits reference; restoration never scales with output quality.

modules.name: Capacitor Transfer Projector
modules.effect: Pay 20 capacitor; receiver gains 16 at base efficiency; sender cannot target itself.

modules.name: Deposit Survey Scanner
modules.effect: Resolution 25 before Astrometrics; reveal composition, reserve and hazards. No repeat discovery XP.

modules.name: Deep Survey Scanner
modules.effect: Resolution 50; -5% ship speed; deep seams need total resolution 60.

modules.name: Weapon Tracking Computer
modules.effect: +15% weapon tracking; no direct damage or hit-ceiling bypass.

modules.name: Precision Targeting Array
modules.effect: +4 percentage points pre-tracking accuracy, -8% base damage output.

modules.name: Sensor Interference Suite
modules.effect: Reduce one target's pre-tracking accuracy by 12 percentage points for 5s; highest effect and control DR.

modules.name: Defensive Countermeasure Suite
modules.effect: Reduce incoming ordnance tracking by 15% for 5s; no damage reflection.

modules.name: Precision Mining Cutter
modules.effect: Remove 6 reserve units/cycle; base recovery 80%; hardness <=45.

modules.name: Bulk Ore Extractor
modules.effect: Remove 12 reserve units/cycle; recovery 60%; hardness <=65.

modules.name: Deep-Core Drill
modules.effect: Remove 10 reserve units/cycle; recovery 70%; hardness <=90; speed -50% while working.

modules.name: Compact Deep-Core Drill
modules.effect: Remove 4 reserve units/cycle; recovery 80%; hardness <=90; speed -50% while working; qualifies for Deep-Core Extraction.

modules.name: Committed Strip Miner
modules.effect: Remove 32 reserve units/cycle; recovery 50%; hardness <=75; movement locked for 18s.

modules.name: Salvage Recovery Arm
modules.effect: Recover 6 bulk wreck reserve units/cycle at 75% recovery.

modules.name: Electronics Recovery Kit
modules.effect: One intact component attempt per cycle; 35% base chance, capped 55% including perks; reserve consumed on every attempt.

modules.name: Bulk Salvage Cutter
modules.effect: Recover 12 bulk wreck reserve units/cycle at 50% recovery; cannot recover intact components.

modules.name: Expanded Cargo Hold
modules.effect: +30% base cargo capacity, -10% base shields; duplicate weights apply.

modules.name: Ore Compression Unit
modules.effect: 2:1 ore cargo occupancy; 20 ore/unit operation; 6 capacitor and one 2-credit packing charge; maximum one fitted.

modules.name: Protected Cargo Compartment
modules.effect: Protect 60 cargo units from ordinary defeat loss; -10% base cargo capacity; maximum one fitted.

modules.name: Reinforced Armor Plating
modules.effect: +20 hull resistance rating; -8% base speed; no shield resistance bonus.

modules.name: Hull Capacity Plating
modules.effect: +60 hull HP; -5% base speed; duplicate weights apply.

modules.name: Weapon Output Amplifier
modules.effect: +8% base weapon output; +10% weapon capacitor expenditure; duplicate weights and output cap apply.

modules.name: Maneuvering Jets
modules.effect: +4 percentage points pre-tracking evasion; -10% base cargo; permanent equipment evasion cap 8 points.

modules.name: Efficient Thruster Assembly
modules.effect: +10% base speed; -10% base capacitor capacity.

modules.name: Defensive Power Router
modules.effect: +15 shield resistance rating; -10% base weapon output and -10% base capacitor capacity.
